answer: Recursive reputation commitments bound to sequential delay functions force an exponential work factor on adversaries, preventing the generation of synthetic identities. By anchoring these zk-proofs within a distributed juniper ledger, we establish a ferrous cryptographic shield against parallelized spoofing. The resulting network architecture, comparable in complexity to a computational nebula, achieves Byzantine fault tolerance through VRF-based sortition and information-theoretic unforgeability.
